OFFLINE DECOMPILATION: adventure attack / wrestling panel helper dependencies
Source: local Windows 53.16 Steam/reference and official/classic PE files named
by data/runtime/native-pe-images.json. Addresses below are reference RVAs;
helper-edition-function-ranges.tsv records the corresponding classic ranges.
This is source reconstruction, not an executed game display or a test report.
All pointer loads, SSE copies, integer copies and printable movabs constants
are recorded in helper-reference-literals.tsv and helper-classic-literals.tsv.
The .pdata table splits some functions into adjacent fragments; the complete
skill-rating and item-name helpers include these fragments explicitly.

1. SELECTED TARGET HEADER: 0x872f10..0x8733a4

render_selected_target(unit, S, right, top):
    # Caller 0x878acf..0x878aeb passes S=panel_left+2,
    # right=panel_right-10 and top=panel_top+2.
    draw_texture_rectangle(S, right, top, top+7)
    draw_portrait_frame(S, S+11, top, top+5)
    draw_native_unit_portrait_or_character(unit)
    # 0x8732b9..0x87331c, mode=1, r9b=1, stack byte=1:
    draw_text(S+13, top+1, unit_identity_132e430(unit, mode=1), white)
    y = top+2
    for action in unit.actions_at_7d0:
        if action.type == -1: continue
        # 0x87333f..0x873355; maximum six status rows:
        draw_cursor(S+16, y)
        render_action_status_852640(action, unit)
        y += 1
        if y >= top+8: break

The screenshot's cyan Talking field belongs to status enum 7, not a Talk
button. The name and status therefore have different native x anchors.
The multiple-target list branch in 0x878600 uses the same identity and status
helpers, key at L+13, name at L+15, status at L+18, eight rows per record.
0x872d70..0x872ed9 only calculates panel bounds; it formats no text.

2. ACTION STATUS: 0x852640..0x8540fc

render_action_status(action, owner):
    # type=int32(action+0), dispatch table 0x8540fc, valid range 0..27.
    switch action.type:
        0 at 0x852691: movement()
        1 at 0x852b5e: attack()
        2 at 0x853124: emit("Jumping")
        3 at 0x853238: emit("Holding terrain")
        4 at 0x8532a7: emit("Releasing hold on terrain")
        5 at 0x853642: emit("Climbing")
        6 at 0x8536f8: emit("Working")
        7 at 0x853792: emit("Talking")
        8 at 0x8535e5: emit("Regaining balance")
        9 at 0x8537f5: emit("Parrying")
       10 at 0x853847: emit("Blocking")
       11 at 0x853899: dodge()
       12 at 0x853bf6: deflection_recovery()
       13 at 0x853d19: emit("Standing Up")
       14 at 0x853d7f: emit("Lying Down")
       15 at 0x8536f8: emit("Working")
       16 at 0x8531dc: emit("Pushing Object")
       17 at 0x853694: emit("Sucking Blood")
       18 at 0x8534a8: emit("Holding item")
       19 at 0x853502: emit("Releasing hold on item")
       20 at 0x85331a: emit("Mounting")
       21 at 0x85336c: emit("Dismounting")
       22 at 0x8533d2: emit("Leading animal")
       23 at 0x853437: emit("Stop leading animal")
       24 at 0x853ddb: load_ammo()
       25 at 0x853fbb: emit("Shooting weapon")
       26 at 0x85405f: emit("Throwing item")
       27 at 0x853572: emit("Recovering after shooting")
    default at 0x8531b4: return # no native text

movement():
    # 0x8526a2, action+0x1c bit0:
    emit("Charging" if action.flags_1c & 1 else "Moving")
    if owner.path_x_at_c8 is empty: return
    # owner current x/y/z are int16 at +a8/+aa/+ac. For a carried rider
    # (owner+110 bit0x02000000), reference type 11 obtains carrier coords
    # through virtual calls and 0xc8baa0 instead.
    origin = owner_or_carrier_position
    destination = first(owner.path_x_c8, owner.path_y_e0, owner.path_z_f8)
    emit(" ")
    emit_lowercase_direction(origin, destination)

dodge():
    # 0x8538f7..0x853912: int16 triples at action+08/+0a/+0c and
    # action+14/+16/+18 are the source and destination.
    emit("Dodging")
    emit(" ")
    emit_lowercase_direction(action.source_position, action.destination_position)

emit_lowercase_direction(origin, destination):
    if destination.y > origin.y:
        emit("southeast" if destination.x > origin.x else
             "southwest" if destination.x < origin.x else "south")
    elif destination.y < origin.y:
        emit("northeast" if destination.x > origin.x else
             "northwest" if destination.x < origin.x else "north")
    elif destination.x > origin.x: emit("east")
    elif destination.x < origin.x: emit("west")
    elif destination.z > origin.z: emit("upward"); return
    elif destination.z < origin.z: emit("downward"); return
    else: return
    if destination.z > origin.z: emit(" (above)")
    elif destination.z < origin.z: emit(" (below)")

attack():
    target = unit_by_id(action+08) # lookup global unit vector 0x23e50b0
    active = int32(action+48) > 0
    if target is missing:
        text = "Attacking" if active else "Recovering from attacking"
        emit_attack_text(text)
        return
    reveal = 0
    if target == player_unit:
        target_text = "you"
        # Search player fields +dfc, +e24 and +e9c for this owner's unit
        # id (+130) and action id (+04); selected int32 supplies reveal.
        reveal = player_reveal_flags_for(owner.id, action.id)
    else:
        target_text = reference_1331500(target)
    text = ""
    if active and reveal & 4:
        stage = int32(action+48)
        text += "Remote: " if stage >= 5 else "Distant: " if stage == 4 else
                "Starting: " if stage == 3 else "Incoming: " if stage == 2 else
                "IMMINENT: " if stage == 1 else ""
    text += ("Attacking" if active else "Recovering from attacking")
    text += " " + target_text
    method = int32(action+0c)
    if method == 0: text += " with wrestling"
    elif method == 1: text += " with grab"
    elif int32(action+24) != -1:
        weapon = item_by_id(action+24)
        if weapon exists:
            text += " with "
            if active and reveal & 8: text += attack_style_flags(action+3c)
            text += item_name_c65450(weapon, mode=0, argument=-1)
            if active and reveal & 1:
                text += " "
                attacks = weapon.virtual_at_438()
                if attacks exists and not attacks.empty:
                    raw_attack = attacks[int32(action+2c)]
                    if raw_attack.sub_name_at_50 != "NO_SUB":
                        text += raw_attack.sub_name_at_50 + " "
                    text += raw_attack.name_at_10
                else: text += "strike"
    elif reveal & 1:
        text += " with "
        if active and reveal & 8: text += attack_style_flags(action+3c)
        natural_attack_index = int32(action+2c)
        if natural_attack_index == -1: text += "push"
        else:
            natural_attack = owner.body_at_5f8.attacks_at_18[natural_attack_index]
            text += bodypart_13345d0(owner, natural_attack.bodypart_at_08,
                                   ordinal=0, grammatical_number=2)
            text += " " + natural_attack.name_at_40
    if active and reveal & 2 and int16(action+28) != -1:
        text += ", aiming for "
        text += bodypart_13345d0(target, int16(action+28), 0, 2)
    emit_attack_text(text)

attack_style_flags(flags):
    # Independent bits, appended in this order; combinations are possible.
    result = ""
    if flags & 0x20: result += "quick"
    if flags & 0x40: result += "heavy"
    if flags & 0x80: result += "wild"
    if flags & 0x100: result += "precise"
    if result != "": result += " "
    return result

emit_attack_text(text):
    # 0x8530e2..0x853110 uses the ordinary native string renderer.
    # 0x52d910 is called only if text.size exceeds global dimx 0x23cd784.
    if text.size > native_screen_dimx: native_string_helper_52d910(text)
    emit(text, color=4, background=0, bright=1)

deflection_recovery():
    text = "Recovering from deflection"
    # Optional item id=int32(action+0c), global item vector 0x23e5450.
    if item_by_id(action+0c) exists:
        text += " with " + item_name_c65450(item, 0, -1)
    emit(text)

load_ammo():
    item = item_by_id(int32(action+0c))
    # 0x853e5f..0x853e88, virtual item type equals 24 and
    # its raw subtype (item+e8) int32+1cc equals 0 selects Nocking.
    text = "Nocking" if item and item.virtual_type() == 24 and
                         int32(item.raw_subtype_at_e8+1cc) == 0 else "Loading"
    text += " ammo"
    emit(text)

3. DEFENSIVE SKILL RATINGS, not arbitrary skill-name labels

rating_text_7737c0(destination, rating):
    destination = ""
    # unsigned comparison at 0x7737db and table 0x77394c:
    if uint32(rating) > 14: return "Legendary"
    return ["Dabbling", "Novice", "Adequate", "Competent", "Skilled",
            "Proficient", "Talented", "Adept", "Expert", "Professional",
            "Accomplished", "Great", "Master", "High Master", "Grand Master"][rating]

The native panel calls this helper rather than the general ranked-skill
formatter. It emits neither a skill name nor Legendary+N, rust markers,
or Not. All sixteen native outcomes use the existing text::skill_rating
resolver, which returns an ability rating instead of a generic adjective.

defensive_labels_in_renderer():
    # Stage 2 root Dodge at 0x879d1e/0x879d2a:
    "Dodge (" + rating_text(effective_skill(player, 0x67)) + ")"
    # Stage 2 root Block at 0x879d82/0x879d8e:
    "Block (" + rating_text(effective_skill(player, 0x2c)) + ")"
    # Stage 6 selected shield at 0x879977:
    "Block " + optional_attack_item_name + " with " + item_name(shield) +
        " (" + rating_text(effective_skill(player, 0x2c)) + ")"
    # Selected parry 0x879c68..0x879c9a, then max /4 Fighter 0x61:
    "Parry " + optional_attack_item_name + " with " + item_name(weapon) +
        " (" + rating_text(max(weapon_skill(player, weapon, true),
                              effective_skill(player, 0x61) / 4)) + ")"
    # Root Parry 0x879e26..0x879e99 scans all available weapon pointers:
    "Parry (" + rating_text(max_over_weapons(max(weapon_skill(player, w, true),
                              effective_skill(player, 0x61) / 4))) + ")"

weapon_skill_133e700(player, weapon, use_primary):
    if weapon is null: skill_id = 0x63
    elif use_primary: skill_id = weapon.virtual_at_4f0()
    else: skill_id = weapon.virtual_at_4f8()
    return effective_skill_133e7a0(player, skill_id)

effective_skill_133e7a0(unit, skill_id):
    if unit.current_soul_at_a98 is null or uint16(skill_id) == 0xffff: return 0
    skill = lookup_skill_0ba1a0(skill_id, unit.current_soul+218)
    rating = max(0, skill.rating_at_04 - skill.rust_penalty_at_10) if skill else 0
    # The remaining numeric-only branches adjust rating for unit state.
    # Five independent half penalties: +81c/+7fc/+7fe/+820/+980 if >0
    # and unit+814==-1. 0x13835e0()==0 quarters this result.
    # +818>=100 with +814!=0 and +360==-1 halves; +984>=2000/4000/6000
    # repeatedly multiplies by 3/4 when +814!=0. +828/+82c flags and
    # unit+9a8 curse/status enum0x2e may apply 1/2 or 3/4.
    # Mode global 0x189c298==0: +98c>=50000, +988>=75000,
    # +990>=150000 each halves. Other mode uses stepped thresholds:
    # +98c: 115200=>9/10,172800=>3/4,345600=>1/2;
    # +988: 172800=>9/10,1209600=>3/4,2592000=>1/2;
    # +990: 172800=>9/10,259200=>3/4,345600=>1/2,864000=>1/4.
    return native_state_adjusted_rating

4. COMPACT DIRECTION CAPTION: 0x74f220..0x74f3a9

append_direction(origin_x, origin_y, origin_z, destination_x, destination_y,
                 destination_z, string):
    if destination_x < origin_x:
        string += "NW" if destination_y < origin_y else
                  "SW" if destination_y > origin_y else "West"
    elif destination_x > origin_x:
        string += "NE" if destination_y < origin_y else
                  "SE" if destination_y > origin_y else "East"
    elif destination_y < origin_y: string += "North"
    elif destination_y > origin_y: string += "South"
    elif destination_z < origin_z: string += "Below"; return
    elif destination_z > origin_z: string += "Above"; return
    else: string += "Here"; return
    if destination_z < origin_z: string += "/Below"
    elif destination_z > origin_z: string += "/Above"

Thus all eleven base strings and both optional suffixes belong to the Dodge
destination label; a complete grammar must accept NW/Above etc. independently
of the lowercase movement/status direction grammar.

5. BODYPART: 0x13345d0..0x1334819

bodypart(unit, bodypart_index, ordinal, number):
    # index=int16(R8), ordinal=int32(R9), number=int16(stack argument).
    # number==0 selects plural names; other values select singular names,
    # except number==2 can use plural for the root of a multi-count part.
    if index < 0 or index >= unit.body_at_5f8.bodyparts.size:
        return "body parts" if number == 0 else "body part"
    part = unit.body_at_5f8.bodyparts[index]
    # part+90 is singular-name vector, part+a8 plural-name vector.
    if part.singular_names is empty:
        return optional_ordinal_prefix(ordinal) +
               ("body parts" if number == 0 or
                (ordinal == 0 and part.count_at_84 > 1 and number == 2)
                else "body part")
    if ordinal > 0 and ordinal < part.singular_names.size:
        return part.plural_names[ordinal] if number == 0 else part.singular_names[ordinal]
    result = optional_ordinal_prefix(ordinal)
    if number == 0 or (ordinal == 0 and part.count_at_84 > 1 and number == 2):
        return result + part.plural_names[0]
    return result + part.singular_names[0]

optional_ordinal_prefix(n):
    return ordinal_52eb70(n, numeric=false) + " " if n > 0 else ""

ordinal_52eb70(n, numeric):
    if numeric: return decimal(n) + English_ordinal_suffix(n)
    if n < 0: return "Negative " + ordinal_52eb70(-n, false)
    if n <= 19:
        return ["Zeroth", "First", "Second", "Third", "Fourth", "Fifth",
                "Sixth", "Seventh", "Eighth", "Ninth", "Tenth", "Eleventh",
                "Twelfth", "Thirteenth", "Fourteenth", "Fifteenth",
                "Sixteenth", "Seventeenth", "Eighteenth", "Nineteenth"][n]
    return decimal(n) + English_ordinal_suffix(n)

Bodypart labels originate in loaded RAW BODY/BP and creature
INDIVIDUAL_NAME/singular/plural data, not a fixed English enum. The installed
health::bodypart::bodypart_main and raw_names grammars own these labels.
The existing bodypart source vocabulary therefore remains the source of
all anatomy labels, including unusual creatures, singular/plural names and
numbered parts. The fallback body part/body parts is also native text.

6. IDENTITY / REFERENCE / ITEM NAME DYNAMIC FIELDS

unit_identity_132e430(unit, mode=1, r9=1, final_byte=1):
    # Full assembler: helper-reference-identity.asm and classic counterpart.
    # This is a semantic native unit-identity formatter; same-spelled names
    # cannot be translated as generic words. Existing native formatter hooks
    # preserve unit owner, RAW species/caste, profession, nick/given/surname,
    # curse/ghost/tame/captive/slave/prisoner states and grammatical form.
    return native_unit_identity_caption

reference_1331500(unit):
    # Full assembler: helper-reference-reference.asm and classic counterpart.
    # All 135 profession dispatch entries and additional name/role/literal
    # branches are already enumerated in adventure-unit-reference-sources.tsv.
    # Profession table at 0x1333508, ordinary branch 0x1331df2..0x13331cc.
    # unit+0xa0 profession can be overridden by linked identity+0xac.
    # Species, curse, appearance, entity title and given/generated names are
    # dynamic RAW/history fields; authored custom names remain authored.
    return native_unit_reference_caption

item_name_c65450(item, mode=0, argument=-1):
    # Full adjacent fragments 0xc65450..0xc65f0a. Apart from " (copy)",
    # visible text is virtual/RAW/authored data rather than fixed constants.
    # Existing ordinary item grammar/native item capture owns complete
    # material, quality, wear, stack/count, improvements and artifact names.
    # Virtual methods +508/+518/+5d8/+5e0/+5e8/+5f0/+1d8 provide item
    # adornments, names and base nouns. Item copies can use written-content
    # title from global0x24e7cb8 + " (copy)" (0xc656cf..0xc6570a).
    return complete_native_item_name

weapon_attack_name(weapon, attack_index):
    attacks = weapon.virtual_at_438()
    attack = attacks[attack_index]
    return (attack.sub_name_at_50 + " " if attack.sub_name_at_50 not in
            ["", "NO_SUB"] else "") + attack.name_at_10

natural_attack_name(unit, attack_index):
    attack = unit.body_at_5f8.attacks_at_18[attack_index]
    return bodypart(unit, attack.bodypart_at_08, 0, 2) + " " + attack.name_at_40

NO_SUB is a RAW sentinel examined by branch predicates, not visible text.
The attack names originate in ITEM_WEAPON attack records and CREATURE_ATTACK
verbs; the panel's fixed verb/type labels are separately reconstructed in
decompiled-panel.txt. New generated personal names are not a finite static
word list; NativeUnitIdentity remains their complete semantic source.
